title: Friend Mike secretly watched Buer and Drew race independently

tellings.quote: He knew about us working on this independently for years and never told us, never did.

plain: For years, a friend named Mike knew that Charles Buhler and Andrew Arjima were each working on the same propulsion idea separately, and never told either of them, says Buhler, an engineer the episode presents as a NASA chief. Buhler tells Michels he found this out around 2016 in Florida: "He knew about us working on this independently for years and never told us, never did."
